_what: The documents a client is asked to upload on the Documents tab. Every client gets `standard`; a state in `by_state` adds its own. A client whose program_track matches a `by_program` entry for their state gets that entry's list instead of standard + state (California's state program asks for a different set). A client's list can be changed per client (client_update documents / add_documents / remove_document_keys, or the Grant Writing page); once changed, the stored list wins until it is reset. Keys must start with up_ and are the upload's key in intake_uploads. `ready` is the short line in the checklist's submission box; `task` is the checklist stem that also satisfies it (marked Completed) or takes it out of the box (marked Not applicable).
